acceptance: Tests that fail on develop and pass after: a dispute reply event plans a re-judgement; an untrusted or non-Dispute reply plans nothing; dispute rounds do not consume budget; a third forced round is refused with an escalation message naming the adjudication grammar; WITHDRAW clears the finding at the next decision; MAINTAIN closes the dispute; an edited, late or wrong-head adjudication is ignored; the merge digest lists adjudications.
Live: one real dispute is re-judged within minutes of posting (record PR and run), or context records that none occurred before the batch ended.
docs/agent/merge-authority.md and docs/internal/oracle-review-v2.md describe adjudication and the narrowed stand-in.

make pr-preflight, make docs-reference-inventory-check, make doc-contracts-guard and make comment-policy-check pass; the PR gets oracle SHIP on its exact head with every oracle thread answered and resolved, and merges through make pr-arm.
context: OWNER DECISIONS 2026-10-26 (asked in session via the choice dialog, answered by joeharris76; full list in the linked decisions file): Q5 exempt dispute rounds and escalate to owner adjudication, replacing stand-ins for disputed findings; Q7 stand-in evidence rule (PR, head, Owner instruction) applies to adjudication too.
description:
Problem: a Dispute: reply triggers nothing, because oracle-verdict.yml does not subscribe to review-comment events; the dispute waits for an unrelated push or rerun (median 47 minutes, up to 19 hours). Dispute reruns consume the 6-per-day manual budget with backoff (retry.py:83-104). After two forced rounds the only exit is a stand-in that waives the whole head with no per-finding reasoning (protocol.py:353-387).

Outcome (owner Q5):
- A Dispute: reply from a trusted association on an unresolved oracle thread triggers a same-head re-judgement through the driver.
- Up to 2 dispute rounds per patch digest are exempt from the manual budget and backoff.
- A finding maintained twice becomes escalated; the gate's waiting message names the exact owner action.
- An owner comment 'Oracle adjudication: WITHDRAW D<n> - <reason>' or 'Oracle adjudication: MAINTAIN D<n> - <reason>' from the attester account (same checks as stand-ins: exact grammar, unedited, posted after the escalation, for the current head) records a terminal per-finding disposition. A finding withdrawn by adjudication no longer blocks the verdict; MAINTAIN closes the dispute.
- Stand-ins remain only for absence, oversize and refusal; docs/agent/merge-authority.md says so.
- Adjudications appear in the merge digest.

Decision gates:
1. The trigger runs trusted develop code only, filters to trusted associations and the Dispute marker before any work, and never cancels an in-flight review needlessly; if GitHub event semantics make a direct subscription unsafe, use a trusted lightweight dispatcher instead and record why.
2. Adjudication identity reuses the stand-in attester checks; record that, because agents share the owner account (owner-agent-identity-20261021 is blocked), the control is audit-only like stand-ins, and require an Owner instruction comment first.
3. Prove an author cannot loop disputes on one patch beyond 2 exempt rounds.

Item guardrails: no change to the evidence rules (previous dispute item); no ruleset change; agents post an adjudication only when the owner names the PR, the finding and the decision in the current request (same rule as stand-ins).

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. Never use git stash (refs/stash is shared across worktrees). Commit as Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>, staging explicit paths only; no git add -A, no --no-verify, no SKIP, no agent trailers. Durable text (commits, PR bodies, docs, code) carries no tracker ids, session labels or plan references. Maintained code has no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check). Before publishing run make docs-reference-inventory-check, make doc-contracts-guard and make pr-preflight, and self-review with the code review action, fixing every Critical and Required finding. Publish only with make pr-open: never gh pr create, a raw push-and-open, or a PR-body override line; if make pr-open refuses, stop and report the exact refusal instead of routing around it. Until oracle-omp-pin-single-source-20261026 merges, make pr-open may run only with PATH prefixed by the darwin-arm64 omp 18.12.1 build whose SHA-256 that item records, verified with shasum immediately before use; never any other side-loaded omp. Close out only with oracle SHIP on the exact head, every oracle thread answered (reply naming the fixing SHA, then resolve) and make pr-arm; never raw gh pr merge, a stand-in, an adjudication, or a ruleset or settings change. Never print tokens, keys, or the gateway URL or hostname; never spend model quota outside the review harness. Owner decisions are recorded in context and in the decisions file; a step that would contradict one stops and asks the owner.
